note: Verbatim recommendation text for each step (ERC First Aid).

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, ABCDE (Table 3), B-Breathing
excerpts.text: Are there any signs of hypoxia (bluish discoloration of lips, nails or skin)?

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, ABCDE (Table 3), B-Breathing
excerpts.text: Assess oxygen saturation level with a pulse oximetry.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Use of a pulse oximetry and use of oxygen
excerpts.text: Give oxygen to a person with difficulty breathing and looking cyanosed (blue tinged) but only if you are trained in its use.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Use of a pulse oximetry and use of oxygen
excerpts.text: Give oxygen via a simple facemask or non-rebreathing mask and then titrate flow rate to maintain an oxygen saturation of 94–98 %.

excerpts.section: ERC 2025 First Aid, Concise guidelines for clinical practice, Use of a pulse oximetry and use of oxygen, life-threatening hypoxaemia
excerpts.text: In the presence of life-threatening hypoxaemia (oxygen saturation <88 %) give oxygen with a higher flow to everyone
